# scipix/tests/fixtures/expected

Expected OCR outputs (golden files) for fixture inputs.

## Files

- `simple_addition.txt` - Expected text for the simple-addition fixture image.
- `simple_fraction.txt` - Expected output for a simple fraction.
- `quadratic.txt` - Expected output for a quadratic-equation fixture.
